attributes.board_name: Colorado Division of Professions and Occupations – State Office of Occupational Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing Professional Development (CPD) program: complete the Reflective Self-Assessment Tool, write a Learning Plan, then at least 24 PDA in at least 2 categories (max 12 PDA per category). Categories include coursework (in person or online, hour-for-hour), fieldwork supervision (Level 1 = 1 PDA per student, Level 2 = 1 PDA per week per student), group study, independent learning, mentoring, publishing, presenting and others in the CPC Manual. No pre-approved providers.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CPC requirements start only after the first renewal of the initial license.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; PDA count only for the license period in which completed.
rules.alternatives: Deemed Status: meeting the continuing-competency program of an approved body (currently NBCOT or the Colorado Department of Education) that includes a knowledge/skills assessment and at least 24 hours per 2-year period. Active-duty military exemption (120+ days federally funded active duty) must be pre-approved.
rules.audit_note: Audits after each license period; do not send documents unless notified. Keep documentation at least 5 years.
rules.notes: 1 PDA = 1 clock hour (60 minutes). Licenses expire 12/31 of even-numbered years (current cycle ends 12/31/2026, renewal possible through 2/28/2027 with late status). CPC Manual Rev. 1/2026.
rules.rule_quote: Completion of at least 24 hours of continuing education or learning activities during each 2-year license period.
